About Me
I am a graduate student in Applied Economics at the university of Winnipeg. I have completed my undergraduate and master’s degree in Economics at Shahjalal University of Science and Technology in Bangladesh. My academic interests include Macroeconomics, Applied Econometrics, Macroeconomic policy. I am particularly interest in using theory and econometric methods to analyze Macroeconomic issues and evaluate the effects of economic policies.
